.av{position:absolute;width:74px;height:74px;border-radius:50%;padding:3px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--lime),var(--lav));box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35)} .av .a5{right:204px;top:185px} .a6{right:315px;top:110px}.feature{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.35fr .65fr;gap:18px;align-items:stretch} .caption{max-width:370px;background:rgba(6,11,13,.82);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:18px;padding:14px 16px;color:#e5edf5;font-size:15px;line-height:1.42} .aside-stack{display:grid;gap:18px} .mini-card{min-height:230px;position:relative} .mini-card .overlay2{position:absolute;inset:auto 18px 18px .lead{font-size:21px;color:#bcc8d2;max-width:860px} .process-model{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.95fr 1.05fr;gap:38px;align-items:center} .steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:12px} .step{padding:18px;border:1px solid .video-card{border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--shadow)} video{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;background:#000} .video-copy{display:grid;gap:14px} .bullet{display:flex;gap:14px;padding:18px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid .gcard{border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--shadow)} .gcard img{aspect-ratio:16/9;width:100%;object-fit:cover} .ginfo{padding:18px 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:34px} .pcard{padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.04),rgba(255,255,255,.02))} .pcard .num{font-size:12px;color:var(--lime);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em} .pcard h3{margin:28px 0 9px;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:-.04em} .pcard p{margin:0;color:#b8c5ce}.apps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.95fr 1.05fr;gap:38px;align-items:center} .app-mock{position:relative;min-height:420px} .appA,.appB{position:absolute;border-radius:24px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0d1519;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow)} .appA{left:0;top:20px;width:62%;height:320px;transform:rotate(-4deg)} .appB{right:0;bottom:0;width:64%;height:280px;transform:rotate(5deg)} .bar{height:40px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 14px;font-size:11px;color:#a6b3be} .dots{display:flex;gap:5px} .dots i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)} .body{padding:20px} .profile{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)} .profile:last-child{border-bottom:0} .profile img{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;outline:2px solid var(--lime)} .profile b{display:block;font-size:14px} .profile small{color:#9fb0bc} .match{display:inline-block;margin-top:12px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--lime);color:#08100d;font-weight:800;font-size:13px} .choice{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:20px} .choice .badge{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)} .badge 12px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(188,191,255,.25);background:rgba(188,191,255,.12);color:#ecf1ff;font-size:13px} .cta{text-align:center;padding:120px 0} .cta h2{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto} .cta p{max-width:700px;margin:0 auto 28px;color:#bfccd6;font-size:20px} footer{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding:26px 0 48px;color:#96a6b2;font-size:13px} footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.whatsapp-float{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;z-index:50;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:12px 15px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--lime);color:#08100d;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:36px;align-items:start}.contact-actions{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:24px}.contact-action{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding:16px small{display:block;color:#9fb0bc;margin-top:3px}.form-card{padding:26px;border-radius:24px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0a1115;color:#eef5fa;font:inherit;outline:none}.form-card textarea{min-height:92px;resize:vertical}.form-card button{margin-top:16px;border:0;cursor:pointer}.form-note{margin-top:10px;color:#82939f;font-size:12px}.contact-status{display:none;margin-top:12px;color:var(--lime);font-size:13px}@media(max-width:1120px){.floating{position:relative;width:100%;height:120px;top:auto;right:auto;margin-bottom:20px}
